title: Evaluate underdiagnosis and overdiagnosis bias of deep learning model on primary open-angle glaucoma diagnosis in under-served populations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on underdiagnosis and overdiagnosis bias based on sex, race, and age in a medical deep learning model for glaucoma detection.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
